subject: MAP: evaluation stop-conditions & verification scenarios for NovusHealth POC
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Patel <alice@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP: stop-conditions & verification scenarios for POC

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our conversation I put together a short mutual action plan focused specifically on how we’ll decide when the POC is complete (stop-conditions) and how we’ll verify acceptance (verification scenarios / acceptance tests). The attached Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx is the one-pager; I also included a lightweight verification-scenarios.md with concrete test cases.

High-level proposal:
- Duration: 3 weeks of active evaluation + 1 week for sign-off (timeline we discussed).
- Exit gates (must be ALL true to pass):
  1) Functional correctness: canonical prompts pass the golden set with >= 92% relevance/precision.
  2) Latency: p95 inference latency < 150ms for the 1024 token typical path under expected concurrency.
  3) Cost: token cost per 1k requests must be within the committed estimate +/- 15%.
  4) Security/compliance: SOC2 checklist items in the shared spreadsheet marked as “validated”.
  5) Data controls: KV/prefix caching and retention policies configured per your retention policy S3-Retention-90.

Verification scenarios include: A/B prompt suite, adversarial prompts, 10k token stream stress run, and replay of 200 anonymized conversation samples you’ll provide. Each scenario has pass/fail criteria in verification-scenarios.md.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review and flag any stop-gates you want to relax/tighten by EOD Thu (2026-09-30).
2) We schedule a 30m ops alignment session next Tue to lock telemetry and log collection (trace ids, token counts).
3) Redwood to run initial verification scenarios and share raw results + summary dashboard.

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), verification-scenarios.md (text).

If this matches your expectations we’ll convert the MAP into a living doc in your Drive and start the POC next Wed.

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123

From: Alice Patel <alice@novushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NovusHealth Technical PM <techpm@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: stop-conditions & verification scenarios for POC

Jonas —

Appreciate the thorough draft. A few quick notes from my side after an internal sync:
- Functional threshold: can we change the golden set pass threshold to >= 90% (Novus ops prefers a slightly lower bar for initial POC) but require a written plan to reach 92% by GA?
- Latency: 150ms p95 looks good; please add a p99 bucket and note expected value under occasional bursts.
- Add one more exit gate: Data residency confirmation (we need explicit confirmation that logs are stored in us-east-1 and no egress to third-party regions).

We’ll upload the 200 anonymized conversation samples by EOD Friday.

If you can ingest these notes and share an updated MAP by Monday we’ll be set to lock the kickoff.

Thanks —
Alice
Alice Patel
Director of Product, NovusHealth
alice@novushealth.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Draft MAP: stop-conditions & verification scenarios for POC

Marissa/Ben —

Alice pushed back on the 92% golden-set threshold -> wants 90% for POC + plan to 92% by GA. Also asked for p99 latency and explicit data residency confirmation (us-east-1). Can you help with two items:

1) Marissa — add a short plan in verification-scenarios.md describing how we’ll incrementally improve the golden-set score (prompt tuning steps, temperature schedules, reranking). Keep it 3 bullets, focused on measurable changes.
2) Ben — confirm whether logs/metrics/archives can be pinned to us-east-1 and whether anything in our hosted flow could lead to cross-region egress; if there are constraints, propose mitigations we can include in the MAP.

I’m aiming to send an updated MAP back to Alice on Monday.

On urgency — Alice expects the sample upload EOD Fri so we need to be ready to run verification scenarios next week.

Thanks —
Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Draft MAP: stop-conditions & verification scenarios for POC

Jonas —

Drafted three quick improvement steps and added them to verification-scenarios.md (attached):
- Step 1 (Week 1): Prompt templating + canonical prompt expansion (aim for +2-4% lift on precision)
- Step 2 (Week 2): Lightweight reranking layer (beam score + heuristic filters) and 1 epoch of supervised fine-tuning on 500 labeled samples if available
- Step 3 (Week 3): Quantized eval + adversarial prompt hardening; measure regression risk and rollback plan

Each step includes the measurement we’ll report (delta to golden-set, confidence intervals, and which test cases are gated).

Ben — can you confirm data residency by EOD so I can merge into the MAP? If hosted infra cannot promise strict us-east-1-only logs for the hosted trial, note the mitigation (dedicated s3 bucket + VPC endpoint + temp keys) and estimate effort.

—Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Patel <alice@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: stop-conditions & verification scenarios for POC (FINAL)

Alice / team —

Confirming: we can keep logs and archived telemetry in a us-east-1-dedicated S3 bucket for the length of the POC and configure the VPC endpoint to prevent egress to other regions. For the hosted trial we’ll:
- Provision a temporary dedicated bucket (Novus-poc-logs-us-east-1) and limit IAM roles to the PoC run.
- Configure retention to 90 days per your policy and provide an export/erase workflow at sign-off.
- p99 latency under expected burst is typically ~260ms; we’ll include p50/p95/p99 in the verification dashboard.

Jonas — I merged Marissa’s improvement steps and my residency/ops notes into Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx and uploaded a signed PO stub (po_signoff.pdf) to the Drive link below. Once Alice confirms the lowered golden-set threshold (90%), we’re ready to start ingestion and run the scenarios next week.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/novus/POC-MAP
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/xx/NovusHealth-POC-Agreement

Ben Carter
Head of Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx, verification-scenarios.md, po_signoff.pdf
